items.title: Fed升息幾乎成定局反而大漲？美股接下來才是真正考驗
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Almost Certain Yet Stocks Surge? The Real Test for US Equities Lies Ahead
paras: 美國8月通膨數據幾乎確立聯準會(Fed)下周升息1碼的預期，為9月初連續下挫的美股提供些許確定性。然而，升息答案塵埃落定，不代表市場已擺脫困境，高油價、美債殖利率、消費力下滑及企業獲利能否延續成長，仍是年底前的主要考驗。
8月消費者物價指數(CPI)整體與核心月增幅均高於預期。富蘭克林坦伯頓研究院首席投資策略師Jeff Schulze表示，數據顯示基礎通膨壓力仍具黏性，Fed必須升息才能讓通膨重返2%目標，甚至可能在短期內多次升息，但這項預期本身不會成為風險資產的重大推力。
芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估Fed下周升息1碼的機率達84%，高於一個月前的50%；年底前再次升息的機率也升至63%。

油價與殖利率仍是美股兩大逆風

投資人暫時對升息預期感到安心，標普500指數周五開盤一度大漲逾75點，收復本周部分跌幅。更重要的是，10年期美債殖利率在逼近5%後回落3個基點至4.92%，暫時解除估值壓力。
波灣國家可能開會協商和平方案的消息傳出後，布蘭特原油下跌3%至每桶104.50美元，也提振市場情緒。不過，油價過去兩個月已上漲約37%，並連續3個交易日站在100美元上方。
美國汽油均價升至每加侖4.30美元，較去年同期上漲近35%；柴油更首度突破每加侖6美元。能源成本上漲勢必陸續反映在未來數月的通膨數據，並與8月核心物價升溫相互作用，進一步侵蝕家庭購買力。
密西根大學9月消費者信心指數降至47.8，較8月下跌近4點，也接近今年低點。高油價若持續壓縮民眾荷包，可能削弱年底購物旺季的消費支出，對零售商與整體經濟構成壓力。

企業獲利能否撐起高估值？

Edward Jones資深全球策略師Angelo Kourkafas表示，美債殖利率與油價同時攀升，正考驗市場韌性，但美股尚未失去最重要的支柱，也就是快速成長的企業獲利。
問題在於，第三季財報季要到10月13日摩根大通(JPM-US)公布業績才正式展開。在此之前，市場難以忽視油價、就業市場不確定性、龐大AI投資支出及美債殖利率上升等壓力。
華爾街目前預估，標普500成分股第三季合計獲利將達7,687億美元，年增近30%，科技股與銀行股仍將領跑。若企業獲利未能達到如此樂觀的預期，美股估值恐面臨重新調整。
eToro美國投資分析師Bret Kenwell認為，Fed下周的政策論述將決定債市下一步。若Fed把升息形容為防範通膨再起的保險措施，而非長期升息循環的起點，市場可能把它解讀為「鴿派升息」，有助限制長期美債殖利率繼續上揚。
標普500目前僅較5月中旬上漲2.3%，華爾街年底預測中位數也只意味約4%的上漲空間。距離11月期中選舉僅剩53天，在財報季登場前，美股仍須穿越高油價、高殖利率與政策不確定性構成的重重障礙。
paras_en: US August inflation data has almost cemented expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates by one quarter-point next week, giving a bit of certainty to the US stock market that has been slipping since early September. However, the rate‑hike decision being settled does not mean the market has escaped its challenges; high oil prices, Treasury yields, weakening consumer spending and whether corporate earnings can keep growing remain the main tests before year‑end.

August CPI and core CPI both rose month‑over‑month more than expected. Jeff Schulze, chief investment strategist at Franklin Templeton, said the data shows underlying inflation pressure remains sticky, forcing the Fed to hike rates to bring inflation back to its 2% target and possibly raise rates multiple times in the short term, but that expectation itself will not become a major catalyst for risk assets.
The CME FedWatch tool shows the market’s probability of a one‑quarter‑point Fed hike next week at 84%, up from 50% a month ago; the odds of another hike before year‑end have also risen to 63%.

Oil prices and yields remain the two biggest headwinds for US stocks. Investors are temporarily reassured by the rate‑hike outlook, with the S&P 500 jumping more than 75 points on Friday’s open and recouping part of the week’s losses. More importantly, the 10‑year Treasury yield slipped three basis points to 4.92% after nearing 5%, temporarily easing valuation pressure.

After news that Gulf states might meet to negotiate a peace plan, Brent crude fell 3% to $104.50 a barrel, lifting market sentiment. Still, oil has risen about 37% over the past two months and has stayed above $100 for three consecutive trading days.

U.S. gasoline averaged $4.30 per gallon, up nearly 35% from a year ago, and diesel broke $6 per gallon for the first time. Rising energy costs will inevitably feed into inflation data over the coming months and, together with hotter August core prices, further erode household purchasing power.

The University of Michigan’s September consumer sentiment index fell to 47.8, down almost four points from August and near this year’s low. Persistently high oil prices could squeeze household budgets, potentially weakening consumer spending during the year‑end shopping season and putting pressure on retailers and the broader economy.

Can corporate earnings sustain lofty valuations? Angelo Kourkafas, senior global strategist at Edward Jones, said that rising Treasury yields and oil prices are testing market resilience, but US equities have not lost their most important pillar – fast‑growing corporate profits.

The issue is that the third‑quarter earnings season does not officially begin until JPMorgan (JPM‑US) reports results on October 13. Until then, markets can’t ignore pressures from oil prices, labor‑market uncertainty, massive AI investment outlays and climbing Treasury yields.

Wall Street currently estimates that S&P 500 constituents will generate $768.7 billion in Q3 earnings, up nearly 30% year‑over‑year, with tech and banks leading the growth. If corporate profits fall short of this optimistic outlook, US stock valuations could face a fresh adjustment.

eToro US analyst Bret Kenwell believes the Fed’s policy language next week will dictate the next move in the bond market. If the Fed frames the hike as an insurance measure against a resurgence of inflation rather than the start of a long‑term tightening cycle, markets may read it as a “dovish hike,” helping to cap further rises in long‑term Treasury yields.

The S&P 500 is up only 2.3% since mid‑May, and Wall Street’s median year‑end forecast implies roughly a 4% upside. With just 53 days left until the November midterm elections and earnings season still ahead, US stocks must still navigate the heavy obstacles of high oil prices, high yields and policy uncertainty.

items.title: 「要嘛行動、要嘛閉嘴」火熱CPI逼華許兌現鷹派承諾 Fed下周升息箭在弦上
items.title_en: "Either Act or Shut Up" – Hot CPI Forces Warsh to Deliver on Hawkish Promise, Fed Rate Hike Likely Next Week
paras: 美國8月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)升幅高於預期，讓聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在下周政策會議支持升息的壓力陡增。市場認為，這份數據不僅削弱通膨即將自行降溫的論點，也讓華許難以在發表強硬抗通膨演說後繼續按兵不動。
美國勞工統計局周五(11日)公布，排除食品與能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，顯示潛在物價壓力仍然頑強。Inflation Insights創辦人兼總裁Omair Sharif表示，Fed如今已到「拿出行動、否則就閉嘴」的時刻。
數據公布後，聯邦基金期貨顯示，市場預估Fed於9月15日至16日會議升息的機率，由周四約70%躍升至85%以上，並開始押注12月前可能再升息一次。道明銀行(TD Bank)與摩根大通(JPM-US)等機構的經濟學家也轉而預測Fed下周將調高利率。
畢馬威(KPMG)首席經濟學家Diane Swonk表示，最新數據進一步讓Fed政策重心朝升息傾斜，現在的問題已不是是否升息，而是需要升多少才能遏制通膨。

華許公信力面臨關鍵考驗

8月核心通膨上升，很大一部分來自無線通訊服務價格創紀錄上漲。儘管這可能是一次性因素，多名分析師仍認為，Fed已無法繼續單憑未來物價可能改善的期待維持利率不變。
華許8月28日在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會表示，潛在通膨尚未明顯改善，若新數據無法讓官員確信通膨正朝2%目標前進，Fed便「仍有工作要做」。Omair Sharif直言，華許不可能發表這樣的演說，卻不在下一次會議支持升息。
Fed今年已連續5次維持利率不變，但內部支持緊縮的聲浪持續升高。7月會議有3名官員反對按兵不動，主張升息1碼，另有2名不具投票權的官員表示也會支持升息。
Evercore ISI經濟學家團隊認為，下周升息如今幾乎已成定局。華許可能判斷，通膨數據尚不足以忽略油價帶來的額外壓力，並藉由採取行動修補7月記者會後受損的抗通膨公信力，且有望取得多數決策官員支持。

升息恐引爆華許與川普衝突

升息雖有助鞏固華許的抗通膨立場，卻可能激怒任命他的美國總統川普。川普持續要求Fed降息，上周甚至威脅，如果央行不降低利率，將切斷與部分國家的貿易。
白宮國家經濟會議主任Kevin Hassett表示，如果Fed採取重大行動，川普很可能會公開表態。這意味華許一旦支持升息，恐首度與仍稱他為Fed「出色新領袖」的川普正面衝突。
通膨風險也不只來自CPI。伊朗戰事延燒，布蘭特原油周四一度升至每桶109美元；資料中心建設帶來的龐大需求，也被認為不會迅速消退。密西根大學調查顯示，消費者一年期通膨預期由8月的4%升至9月初的4.6%，且自2023年以來首次有過半受訪者預期未來一年利率將上升。
在失業率維持低檔、勞動市場大致穩定，且部分官員認為現行利率對需求的抑制程度低於原先預期之際，Fed可能需要收回去年因擔憂就業降溫而實施的3次、合計3碼降息。多數投資人預期，這波調整可能僅升息一至兩次，但部分經濟學家已開始認為，Fed可能需要完全逆轉去年的降息措施。
paras_en: The U.S. August core consumer price index (CPI) rose more than expected, sharply increasing pressure on Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to support a rate hike at next week’s policy meeting. Markets believe the data not only weakens the argument that inflation will cool on its own, but also makes it difficult for Warsh to stay idle after delivering a tough anti‑inflation speech.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released on Friday the 11th that core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, indicating that underlying price pressures remain stubborn. Omair Sharif, founder and president of Inflation Insights, said the Fed is now at the point of “take action or shut up.”

After the data were released, federal‑funds futures showed the market’s probability of a Fed rate hike at the September 15‑16 meeting jumping from about 70% on Thursday to over 85%, and traders began betting on another hike before December. Economists at TD Bank and JPMorgan (JPM‑US) also shifted to forecasting a rate increase next week.

KPMG chief economist Diane Swonk said the latest data further tilt the Fed’s policy focus toward tightening; the question now is not whether to hike, but how much tightening is needed to curb inflation.

Warsh’s credibility faces a crucial test. The August core‑inflation rise was largely driven by a record jump in wireless communication service prices. Although this may be a one‑off factor, several analysts say the Fed can no longer keep rates unchanged based solely on hopes that prices will improve later.

Warsh told the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit on August 28 that underlying inflation has not shown a clear improvement, and if new data do not convince officials that inflation is moving toward the 2% target, the Fed “still has work to do.” Omair Sharif bluntly noted that Warsh cannot give such a speech and then not support a hike at the next meeting.

The Fed has kept rates steady for five consecutive meetings this year, but internal support for tightening continues to rise. At the July meeting, three officials voted against holding rates steady, advocating a 0.25‑point hike, and two non‑voting members also indicated they would back a hike.

Evercore ISI economists say a rate hike next week is now almost a certainty. Warsh may conclude that inflation data are still insufficient to ignore the extra pressure from oil prices, and by acting he can repair the credibility damage to his anti‑inflation stance after the July press conference, while likely securing a majority of voting officials’ support.

Rate hikes could spark a clash between Warsh and President Trump. While a hike would reinforce Warsh’s anti‑inflation position, it could anger President Trump, who appointed him. Trump has repeatedly urged the Fed to cut rates and even threatened last week to cut off trade with certain countries if the central bank does not lower rates.

White House National Economic Council director Kevin Hassett said that if the Fed takes a major action, Trump is likely to comment publicly. This means that if Warsh backs a hike, it could be the first direct confrontation with Trump, who still calls him the Fed’s “outstanding new leader.”

Inflation risks also come from sources beyond CPI. The war in Iran has escalated, pushing Brent crude to $109 a barrel on Thursday, and massive demand from data‑center construction is seen as unlikely to fade quickly. A University of Michigan survey shows one‑year consumer inflation expectations rose from 4% in August to 4.6% in early September, and for the first time since 2023, over half of respondents expect interest rates to rise over the next year.

With unemployment remaining low, the labor market broadly stable, and some officials believing that current rates are less restrictive to demand than previously thought, the Fed may need to roll back the three 0.25‑point cuts it implemented last year out of employment‑cooling concerns. Most investors expect the adjustment to involve only one or two hikes, but some economists now argue the Fed may have to fully reverse last year’s easing measures.

items.title: 油價緩衝用完了！雪佛龍CEO警告未來數月恐續漲
items.title_en: Chevron CEO Warns Oil Price Buffer Exhausted, Future Months May See Further Increases
paras: 雪佛龍(Chevron)(CVX-US)執行長沃斯(Mike Wirth)周五(11日)警告，伊朗戰爭初期用來抑制油價漲勢的額外供應緩衝已經耗盡，未來幾個月油價風險仍偏向上行，短期內恐難迅速回落。
伊朗戰爭自2月底爆發後，多國陸續釋出部分原油庫存，美國也放寬對受制裁國家海上浮動石油庫存的限制，增加市場供應並減緩油價漲勢。然而，沃斯在德州大學奧斯汀分校一場能源會議上表示，這些緩衝措施的效用如今已經消耗殆盡。
沃斯表示，目前已很難想像油價能夠迅速走低，未來數月價格風險仍明顯偏向上行。伊朗戰爭與烏克蘭持續攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，正同步壓縮全球原油與成品油供應。美國柴油均價周四首度升至每加侖6美元，創歷史新高，布蘭特原油本周漲幅也可望達到8%。
談及中亞業務，沃斯表示，川普政府已與烏克蘭討論對俄羅斯黑海地區石油基礎設施的攻擊，此後雪佛龍在當地營運受到的衝擊已經減少。
雪佛龍負責營運哈薩克大型田吉茲油田，並持有裏海石油管線公司股權。該公司營運一條從田吉茲油田通往黑海的出口管線，是哈薩克原油出口的重要通道。
至於委內瑞拉業務，沃斯表示，雪佛龍計劃投入70億美元擴大當地產能，但不會從外部注入資金，相關支出將完全由目前3家合資企業產生的現金支應。
雪佛龍上周已與委內瑞拉政府簽署新合約條款，準備拓展至另外兩個油區，並計劃在2031年前把當地產量提高逾一倍，達到每日約60萬桶。沃斯強調，公司將依照現有合資企業自身創造現金的能力推動擴張。
paras_en: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth warned on Friday the extra supply buffer that was used early in the Iran war to curb oil price gains has been depleted, and oil price risk will remain tilted upward for the next several months, making a rapid decline unlikely in the short term.

Since the Iran war erupted at the end of February, multiple countries have gradually released portions of their crude inventories, and the United States has relaxed restrictions on offshore floating oil storage for sanctioned nations, boosting market supply and tempering price gains. However, Wirth said at an energy conference at the University of Texas at Austin that the effectiveness of those buffer measures has now been exhausted.

Wirth said it is now hard to imagine oil prices falling quickly, and price risk will remain clearly upward in the coming months. The Iran war together with continued attacks on Russian refineries due to the Ukraine conflict are simultaneously squeezing global crude and product supplies. U.S. diesel averaged $6 per gallon on Thursday for the first time, a historic high, and Brent crude is expected to post an 8% gain this week.

Regarding Central Asian operations, Wirth noted that the Trump administration had discussed attacks on Russian Black Sea oil infrastructure with Ukraine, and since then the impact on Chevron’s operations in the region has lessened.
Chevron operates Kazakhstan’s large Tengiz field and holds a stake in the Caspian Pipeline Consortium, which runs a pipeline from Tengiz to the Black Sea and is a key export route for Kazakh crude.

On Venezuelan business, Wirth said Chevron plans to invest $7 billion to expand local capacity but will not inject external funding; the related spending will be fully covered by cash generated by its three existing joint ventures.

Chevron signed new contract terms with the Venezuelan government last week, preparing to expand into two additional oil areas and aiming to more than double local production to about 600,000 barrels per day by 2031. Wirth emphasized the expansion will be driven by the cash‑generating ability of the current joint ventures.

items.title: 綠電再生H1轉盈EPS達0.67元勝去年全年 配息0.35元9/30除息
items.title_en: Green Energy Renewable H1 Turns Profit EPS 0.67 NT$ Beats Last Year Full-Year Dividend 0.35 NT$ Ex-Dividend Sep 30
paras: 綠電再生(8440-TW)在2026年上半年稅後純益3364萬元，除較去年同期由虧轉盈之外， 上半年獲利並超越2025年全年 ，每股純益達0.67元，今(11)日公司董事決議上半年配息0.35元，也勝過去年全年0.2元配息，並訂9月30日除息交易。
綠電2026年上半年營收4.46億元，毛利率回升到19.24%，年增13.23個百分點，稅後純益3364萬元，除較去年同期由虧轉盈之外， 上半年獲利並超越2025年全年的1544 萬元 ，每股純益達0.67元
綠電2026年1-8月營收6.7億元，年減1.31%。在國際銅價走高同時，今年營收可望出現逐季回升走勢。
paras_en: Green Energy Renewable (8440-TW) posted a net profit after tax of NT$33.64 million in the first half of 2026, turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year. The H1 profit also exceeded the full‑year 2025 result, with earnings per share of NT$0.67. Today (the 11th) the board approved a dividend of NT$0.35 per share for the first half, higher than the NT$0.20 per share paid for the entire last year, and set the ex‑dividend date for September 30.

In H1 2026, Green Energy recorded revenue of NT$4.46 billion, with gross margin rebounding to 19.24%, up 13.23 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$33.64 million, again turning a loss into a profit versus the same period last year, and surpassing the full‑year 2025 profit of NT$15.44 million, with EPS of NT$0.67.

For the January‑August 2026 period, Green Energy’s revenue was NT$6.7 billion, a 1.31% decline year‑over‑year. With international copper prices rising, the company expects revenue to show a sequential recovery throughout the year.

items.title: 中石化：京華城土地仍遭扣押  鼎越預計9月底提出變更建照設計報告
items.title_en: Sinopec: Jinghua City Land Still Seized, Dingyue Plans to Submit Revised Building Permit Design Report by End of September
paras: 石化股中石化(1314-TW)今(11)日舉行法說會，外界持續關注中石化旗下子公司持股100％的鼎越開發及京華廣場案目前進度。對此，中石化總經理陳穎俊也回應，一切將依鼎越今(2026)年5月22日股東會決議，擬以728%容積率出售土地，後續依照相關規範及法令辦理，也強調鼎越目前已提出第4次抗告，仍待高等法院更審及裁定，未來將依循法令，完成土地處分事宜，預計本(9)月底提送變更建照設計報告送審。
針對京華廣場土地目前仍受到扣押，陳穎俊表示，台北地院於今年4月8日也第4度裁定准予扣押京華廣場土地，目前鼎越公司已於6月提出第4次抗告，案件進度仍待台灣高等法院更審及裁定。
陳穎俊也說明，在容積獎勵撤銷及變更設計案部分，台北市政府於5月22日撤銷20％容積獎勵，鼎越公司則在6月申請建照變更設計展期，預計本(9)月底提送變更建照設計報告送審。
此外，目前截至今年8月底，鼎越開發與銀行的聯貸案借款餘額為58.8億元，中石化表示，後續將與銀行團討論還款規劃。
中石化今年上半年營收為80億元、年減30%，稅後淨損19.86億元、每股淨損為0.52元。
中石化高層表示，公司上半年在本業營運改善下，對稅後損益挹注了7.39億元，但因已喪失對中華工程(2515-TW)重大影響力，將依會計準則重估股權並認列投資損失18.04億元，目前該項虧將屬會記帳面上重估，不影響日常公司營運資金。
paras_en: Sinopec (1314‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (Nov 11). The market continues to watch the progress of the Jinghua Plaza project, which is wholly owned by Sinopec’s subsidiary Dingyue Development. General Manager Chen Ying‑jun said everything will follow the resolution of Dingyue’s shareholders’ meeting on May 22, 2026, which proposes to sell the land at a 7.28‑fold floor‑area ratio. The subsequent steps will comply with relevant regulations and laws. He also noted that Dingyue has filed its fourth appeal, which is pending a higher‑court review and ruling. The land‑disposition matter will be handled according to law, and a revised building‑permit design report is expected to be submitted for review by the end of September.

Regarding the ongoing seizure of the Jinghua Plaza land, Chen said the Taipei District Court ruled for the fourth time on April 8 of this year to allow the seizure. Dingyue filed its fourth appeal in June, and the case now awaits a review and decision by the Taiwan High Court.

Chen also explained that, concerning the removal of floor‑area bonuses and the design‑change case, the Taipei City Government revoked a 20 % floor‑area bonus on May 22. Dingyue applied in June for an extension of the building‑permit design deadline, and it plans to submit the revised design report for approval by the end of September.

As of the end of August this year, Dingyue Development’s syndicated loan balance with banks stood at NT$5.88 billion. Sinopec said it will discuss repayment plans with the lending consortium moving forward.
Sinopec’s revenue for the first half of this year was NT$8.0 billion, a 30 % year‑over‑year decline. After‑tax net loss was NT$1.986 billion, or a loss of NT$0.52 per share.

Senior executives said that, thanks to improvements in core operations, the company injected NT$7.39 billion into after‑tax earnings in the first half. However, having lost significant influence over China Engineering (2515‑TW), Sinopec will re‑value its stake under accounting standards and recognize an investment loss of NT$1.804 billion. This loss is an accounting revaluation and does not affect the company’s day‑to‑day operating cash.

items.title: 高公局推國道服務區響應敬軍優惠 統一超、全家4超商響應支援

高公局表示，此次活動也感謝南仁湖(5905-TW)、新東陽、統一超商(2912-TW)及全家便利商店(5903-TW)，總計共4家經營廠商全力支持與積極響應，於15處服務區指定櫃位，凡出示軍人證或榮民證等，即可享有9折優惠。
高公局表示，今年累計使用1,186次，較去(2025)年1,040次成長14％，其中更以西螺、南投及西湖服務區3個服務區使用最為踴躍。
在服務區消費的國軍朋友表示，收假兵車停靠服務區，剛好有軍人專屬優惠，覺得很棒；九三軍人節享有國道服務區商品9折優惠，感受到滿滿的敬意與支持；平時執行任務辛苦，能在休假或行車途中享有這份優惠，真的很貼心；感謝國道服務區對國軍的支持與肯定，讓我們感受到被記得、被重視的溫暖。高公局表示，這也顯示國軍朋友與眷屬的熱烈支持，也讓更多用路人看見敬軍活動的友善貼心，正是高公局與業者共同展現的溫暖心意。
高公局表示，國軍官兵是國家安定的堅實力量，不論是日常戰備演訓，或是災後的兵力支援，皆能看見他們無私奉獻的身影，希望透過專屬優惠，讓平日辛勞的國軍朋友在出遊或返鄉時，能在國道服務區獲得更好的放鬆體驗。
paras_en: In gratitude for the armed forces’ long‑standing protection of the homeland, the Ministry of Transportation’s Expressway Bureau this year (2026) partnered with operators of national highway service areas to launch the “93rd Military Day Appreciation Discount.” The program, running from August 28 to September 10, expresses sincere respect to all military personnel and their families, recording 1,186 uses and a year‑over‑year increase of 14 %.

The bureau said the event also thanks the four participating operators—Nan Renhu (5905‑TW), Xin Dongyang, Uni-President Convenience Stores (2912‑TW) and FamilyMart (5903‑TW)—which fully support and actively respond by offering a 10 % discount at designated counters in 15 service areas for anyone presenting a military ID or veteran’s card.
The bureau reported a total of 1,186 uses this year, up 14 % from 1,040 uses in 2025, with the most enthusiastic participation observed at the Xiluo, Nantou and Xihu service areas.

Military personnel who shopped at the service areas said that after returning from leave, their troop vehicles stopped at the service area and they were pleased to find a discount just for them. They appreciated the 10 % discount on goods during the 93rd Military Day, feeling the respect and support. They noted that the discount is a thoughtful gesture for those who work hard on missions, and thanked the service areas for recognizing and valuing them, which made them feel remembered and cared for. The bureau said this also shows the strong backing from service members and their families, and helps other road users see the friendly, considerate nature of the military‑appreciation activities, reflecting the warm intent jointly demonstrated by the bureau and operators.

The bureau emphasized that military personnel are a solid force for national stability. Whether in daily combat readiness training or post‑disaster troop support, their selfless dedication is evident. Through this exclusive discount, the bureau hopes that service members can enjoy a more relaxing experience at expressway service areas when traveling or returning home.

items.title: 手機資費竟成最後一根稻草！美國核心通膨超預期 Fed下周恐升息
items.title_en: Mobile Phone Rates End Up as the Final Straw! U.S. Core Inflation Beats Expectations, Fed May Raise Rates Next Week
paras: 美國一波手機資費調漲，意外成為推升8月核心通膨的重要因素，甚至可能成為促使聯準會(Fed)下周升息的最後一根稻草。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五公布，排除食品與能源的核心消費者物價指數(CPI)8月月增0.3%，高於《彭博》調查預估的0.2%。其中，無線電話服務價格單月大漲5.9%，創有紀錄以來最大增幅，並對核心CPI月增率貢獻約0.1個百分點。
換句話說，若排除無線電話服務價格的影響，8月核心CPI月增率僅約0.2%，將與市場預期一致。這項指標主要反映電信業者提供的預付方案與月租方案價格。
美國銀行(BAC-US)、巴克萊(BCS-US)及Pantheon Macroeconomics的經濟學家指出，AT&T(T-US)、T-Mobile US(TMUS-US)等大型電信業者近期調整資費方案，很可能是無線電話服務價格暴漲的主因。
AT&T今年稍早已宣布，部分方案將於8月調漲價格；T-Mobile近期也停止提供若干舊有方案，導致部分用戶必須轉用價格更高的服務。BLS拒絕進一步說明個別電信業者的方案調整如何影響這項數據。
儘管核心通膨超預期可能主要受到一次性因素推動，許多Fed觀察人士仍認為升息理由充分。Inflation Insights總裁謝里夫(Omair Sharif)表示，無線電話服務確實讓核心CPI多出0.1個百分點，排除後的增幅只有0.2%，但Fed在下周會議上恐怕沒有餘裕逐項拆解數據，忽略整體通膨高於預期的結果。
由於8月CPI是Fed決策前最後一項重要通膨數據，這波由手機資費造成的意外漲幅，可能足以讓原本勢均力敵的利率決策倒向升息。
paras_en: A wave of mobile phone rate hikes in the United States unexpectedly became an important factor pushing up core inflation in August, and could even be the final straw that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise rates next week.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released on Friday that the core consumer price index (CPI) for August, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, above Bloomberg’s forecast of 0.2%. Within that, wireless telephone service prices jumped 5.9% in the month, the largest increase on record, contributing about 0.1 percentage point to the core CPI’s monthly gain.

In other words, if the impact of wireless telephone service prices is stripped out, the August core CPI would have risen only about 0.2% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations. This component mainly reflects the prices of prepaid and postpaid plans offered by telecom operators.

Economists at Bank of America (BAC‑US), Barclays (BCS‑US) and Pantheon Macroeconomics said that large carriers such as AT&T (T‑US) and T‑Mobile US (TMUS‑US) recently adjusted their pricing plans, which is likely the main driver of the surge in wireless telephone service prices.

AT&T announced earlier this year that some plans would see price increases in August; T‑Mobile has recently stopped offering several legacy plans, forcing some customers to switch to higher‑priced services. The BLS declined to provide further detail on how individual carriers’ plan changes affected the data.

Although the upside in core inflation may be driven largely by a one‑off factor, many Fed watchers still see ample justification for a rate hike. Omair Sharif, president of Inflation Insights, said that wireless telephone service added 0.1 percentage point to core CPI; without it the increase would be only 0.2%, but the Fed is unlikely to have time at next week’s meeting to dissect the numbers item by item, and will likely overlook the overall inflation being higher than expected.

Because the August CPI is the last major inflation data point before the Fed’s decision, this unexpected rise caused by mobile phone rates could be enough to tip a previously evenly balanced rate‑policy decision toward a hike.

items.title: 俄烏中東「雙戰事」夾擊！柴油、小麥接連告急 全球通膨風暴恐再起
items.title_en: Russia-Ukraine and Middle East “Dual War” Squeeze: Diesel and Wheat Shortages Spark Global Inflation Storm
paras: 中東戰爭再度升溫之際，在數千英里之外的俄烏戰爭也進入艱難的新階段，而這對全球經濟構成的威脅，遠不只是柴油與其他燃料。
俄羅斯與烏克蘭都是全球主要穀物出口國，俄羅斯同時也是燃料出口大國。近幾周，俄羅斯持續對基輔發動致命攻擊，烏克蘭則以更精準的方式襲擊俄羅斯能源基礎設施，造成巨大破壞。
這已成為美國柴油與汽油零售價格上漲的重要因素之一，進一步排擠美國家庭的預算，並加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。
然而，受衝擊的不只是燃料。黑海穀物碼頭遭到攻擊，威脅包括小麥在內的重要糧食出口，加上北半球收成季與冬季即將到來，來自中東的肥料供應仍不順暢。
哥倫比亞大學全球能源政策中心研究員、曾任油田服務巨頭SLB董事的Tatiana Mitrova說：「我正在觀察事態如何發展，我真的感到非常害怕。」
令人擔憂的理由不計可數，俄烏衝突持續升溫之際，川普政府上周末派遣特使庫許納(Jared Kushner)與魏科夫(Steve Witkoff)前往莫斯科與基輔訪問，但沒有取得突破性進展。
俄羅斯目前禁止柴油出口，導致每日約80萬桶柴油出口供應退出市場，這些燃料主要在未受到制裁的市場供應，包括土耳其、巴西及部分非洲國家。如今，這些國家被迫緊急尋找替代供應，產生的骨牌效應是讓歐洲柴油庫存降到危險的低點，美國業者得以介入填補缺口。
最新發展讓美國煉油商Marathon Petroleum(MPC-US)與Valero Energy(VLO-US)上季獲利均大幅飆升，股價也在近幾個交易日屢創新高。但對美國經濟、乃至於全球市場而言，這並不是好消息。
標普全球能源(S&P Global Energy)美洲與歐洲煉油及行銷主管Debnil Chowdhury說：「中東危機掩蓋了俄羅斯供應中斷，以及這對全球柴油供應造成的巨大衝擊。」
他指出，在公共討論中，柴油價格往往被汽油的話題熱度蓋過，但「柴油才是真正的主力燃料」。
Chowdhury表示，柴油價格上漲不會立即反映在消費者的支出上，反而會帶來複合效應，在未來三到六個月逐步傳導至整體經濟。
Chowdhury補充說：「我們正密切關注這一點，在實際層面上，這可能轉化為接下來到年底、及明年的經濟成長疲弱。我們處於一個岌岌可危的局面。」
數據平台Kpler的分析師預估，包括柴油與汽油煉製在內，目前全球煉油產能每日約為8000萬桶，低於往年常見的每日8600萬桶。
此外，近期中東衝突再度升溫，正在打擊沙烏地阿拉伯煉油廠及其他能源設施。俄羅斯約40%的煉油產能目前處於停擺狀態。
Enverus Intelligence Research能源分析師兼主管Al Salazar說：「就算手上有原油、荷姆茲海峽沒有受到限制，而且假設一切都恢復正常，我們仍然無法把原油轉化為成品油。」他解釋，人們消費的不是原油，而是由原油煉製而成的燃料。
原油期貨周四再度大漲，拖累股票與債券市場。倫敦交易的布蘭特原油期貨如今突破每桶107美元，紐約交易的西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨也站上每桶102美元，兩者今年來累積上漲近80%。小麥期貨今年迄今上漲逾46%，其中約一半漲幅在過去三個月出現。

攻擊範圍擴大、衝擊隨之擴散

哥大的Mitrova表示，烏克蘭約從一年前開始對俄羅斯煉油廠及能源基礎設施發動無人機攻擊，但之後持續調整攻擊方式，破壞力也與日俱增。舉例來說，本周三一場無人機攻擊，造成俄羅斯新烏連戈伊(Novy Urengoy)市附近的天然氣設施起火。
無人機不只擴大攻擊範圍，也擴大攻擊規模，壓垮了俄羅斯的防禦能力。比方說，烏克蘭會再次攻擊先前已遭襲擊的煉油廠，使維修工作更加複雜，並拉長煉油廠停擺的時間，而且近期的攻擊似乎經過精心安排，把目標鎖定能源設施中最昂貴、也最難替換的零組件，導致維修所需時間進一步拉長。
Mitrova表示，「俄羅斯持續修復，烏克蘭則是持續摧毀，就像是一場競賽。」
她指出，俄羅斯境內的燃料危機已經「非常明顯」，加油站開始出現排隊隊伍、部分地區實施配給，今年來官方燃料價格約上漲16%，但黑市價格高得多，甚至可能根本買不到燃料。
Mitrova表示，隨著冬季即將到來，情勢可能更加惡化，尤其是在基輔。
此外，黑海以小麥為主體的糧食出口，也面臨威脅。俄羅斯一直試圖透過波羅的海航線轉移穀物出口，但這僅占其黑海出口的一小部分。
她說：「隨著所有穀物被困在黑海，俄羅斯與烏克蘭都無法出口，而肥料又無法從波斯灣地區運來，加上『超級』聖嬰現象等天候因素影響全球農業，糧食安全將受到非常、非常嚴重的影響。」
她表示，到了明年，全球糧食安全將會受到非常明顯的影響，目前已經在新興經濟體已經可以看到這種現象。
paras_en: As the Middle East war heats up again, the Russia-Ukraine conflict thousands of miles away has entered a difficult new phase, posing threats to the global economy that go far beyond diesel and other fuels.

Both Russia and Ukraine are major global grain exporters, and Russia is also a large fuel exporter. In recent weeks Russia has continued lethal attacks on Kyiv, while Ukraine has struck Russian energy infrastructure with increasing precision, causing massive damage.
This has become one of the key drivers of rising retail diesel and gasoline prices in the United States, further squeezing household budgets and heightening market concerns about inflation.

But the impact is not limited to fuels. Attacks on Black Sea grain terminals threaten vital food exports, including wheat, and with the northern‑hemisphere harvest season and winter approaching, fertilizer supplies from the Middle East remain disrupted.

Tatiana Mitrova, a researcher at Columbia University’s Center on Global Energy Policy and former board member of oil‑field services giant SLB, said: “I am watching how the situation unfolds, and I am truly very scared.”

There are countless worrying reasons; as the Russia‑Ukraine clash intensifies, the Trump administration sent envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to Moscow and Kyiv last weekend, but achieved no breakthrough.

Russia has now banned diesel exports, removing roughly 800,000 barrels per day from the market. Those fuels mainly went to non‑sanctioned markets such as Turkey, Brazil and parts of Africa, which are now forced to scramble for alternatives, creating a domino effect that has driven European diesel inventories to dangerously low levels while U.S. firms step in to fill the gap.

The latest developments have sent U.S. refiners Marathon Petroleum (MPC‑US) and Valero Energy (VLO‑US) soaring in profit last quarter, with their shares hitting fresh highs over the past few trading days. Yet this is not good news for the U.S. economy or global markets.

Debnil Chowdhury, head of refining and marketing for the Americas and Europe at S&P Global Energy, said: “The Middle East crisis masks the Russian supply disruption and the huge impact it has on global diesel supply.”
He noted that in public debate diesel prices are often eclipsed by gasoline talk, but “diesel is the real workhorse fuel.”

Chowdhury added that diesel price hikes will not immediately show up in consumer spending; instead they will generate a compound effect that gradually transmits to the broader economy over the next three to six months.
He further said: “We are watching this closely; in practical terms it could translate into weaker economic growth by year‑end and into next year. We are in a precarious situation.”

Analysts at data platform Kpler estimate that global refining capacity – including diesel and gasoline production – is now about 80 million barrels per day, down from the usual 86 million barrels per day in prior years.
Moreover, the recent escalation of Middle East fighting is hitting Saudi Arabian refineries and other energy facilities. About 40 % of Russia’s refining capacity is currently offline.

Enverus Intelligence Research energy analyst and head Al Salazar said: “Even if we have crude oil, the Strait of Hormuz is unrestricted, and everything otherwise returns to normal, we still cannot turn crude into finished fuel.” He explained that people consume not crude oil but the fuels refined from it.

Crude oil futures surged again on Thursday, dragging down equity and bond markets. Brent crude on the London exchange broke above $107 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate in New York topped $102 a barrel, both up nearly 80 % year‑to‑date. Wheat futures have risen more than 46 % this year, with roughly half of that gain occurring in the past three months.

The attack scope is widening and the shock is spreading. Mitrova of Columbia University said Ukraine began drone strikes on Russian refineries and energy infrastructure about a year ago, and has since refined its tactics, increasing the damage. For example, a drone attack on Wednesday set a natural‑gas facility near Novy Urengoy on fire.

Drones are not only expanding the geographic reach of attacks but also their scale, overwhelming Russian defenses. Ukraine may strike the same refinery again, complicating repairs and extending shutdown times, and recent attacks appear meticulously planned to hit the most expensive and hardest‑to‑replace components of energy facilities, further lengthening repair periods.
Mitrova said, “Russia keeps repairing, Ukraine keeps destroying – it’s like a race.”

She noted that the fuel crisis inside Russia is already “very obvious,” with queues at gas stations, regional rationing, official fuel prices up about 16 % this year, while black‑market prices are far higher and fuel may simply be unavailable.
Mitrova warned that as winter approaches the situation could worsen, especially in Kyiv.

In addition, Black Sea wheat‑centric grain exports are under threat. Russia has tried to shift grain shipments through Baltic routes, but this accounts for only a small fraction of its Black Sea exports.

She said: “With all the grain trapped in the Black Sea, neither Russia nor Ukraine can export, fertilizer cannot be brought in from the Persian Gulf, and ‘super’ El Niño‑type weather patterns are hitting global agriculture. Food security will be hit extremely, extremely hard.”
She added that by next year global food security will be visibly impacted, and the effects are already observable in emerging economies.

items.title: 綠電再生H1轉盈EPS達0.67元勝去年全年 配息0.35元9/30除息
items.title_en: Green Energy Renewable H1 Turns Profit EPS 0.67 NT$ Beats Last Year Full-Year Dividend 0.35 NT$ Ex-Dividend Sep 30
paras: 綠電再生(8440-TW)在2026年上半年稅後純益3364萬元，除較去年同期由虧轉盈之外， 上半年獲利並超越2025年全年 ，每股純益達0.67元，今(11)日公司董事決議上半年配息0.35元，也勝過去年全年0.2元配息，並訂9月30日除息交易。
綠電2026年上半年營收4.46億元，毛利率回升到19.24%，年增13.23個百分點，稅後純益3364萬元，除較去年同期由虧轉盈之外， 上半年獲利並超越2025年全年的1544 萬元 ，每股純益達0.67元
綠電2026年1-8月營收6.7億元，年減1.31%。在國際銅價走高同時，今年營收可望出現逐季回升走勢。
paras_en: Green Energy Renewable (8440-TW) posted a net profit after tax of NT$33.64 million in the first half of 2026, turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year. The H1 profit also exceeded the full‑year 2025 result, with earnings per share of NT$0.67. Today (the 11th) the board approved a dividend of NT$0.35 per share for the first half, higher than the NT$0.20 per share paid for the entire last year, and set the ex‑dividend date for September 30.

In H1 2026, Green Energy recorded revenue of NT$4.46 billion, with gross margin rebounding to 19.24%, up 13.23 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$33.64 million, again turning a loss into a profit versus the same period last year, and surpassing the full‑year 2025 profit of NT$15.44 million, with EPS of NT$0.67.

For the January‑August 2026 period, Green Energy’s revenue was NT$6.7 billion, a 1.31% decline year‑over‑year. With international copper prices rising, the company expects revenue to show a sequential recovery throughout the year.

items.title: 中石化：京華城土地仍遭扣押  鼎越預計9月底提出變更建照設計報告
items.title_en: Sinopec: Jinghua City Land Still Seized, Dingyue Plans to Submit Revised Building Permit Design Report by End of September
paras: 石化股中石化(1314-TW)今(11)日舉行法說會，外界持續關注中石化旗下子公司持股100％的鼎越開發及京華廣場案目前進度。對此，中石化總經理陳穎俊也回應，一切將依鼎越今(2026)年5月22日股東會決議，擬以728%容積率出售土地，後續依照相關規範及法令辦理，也強調鼎越目前已提出第4次抗告，仍待高等法院更審及裁定，未來將依循法令，完成土地處分事宜，預計本(9)月底提送變更建照設計報告送審。
針對京華廣場土地目前仍受到扣押，陳穎俊表示，台北地院於今年4月8日也第4度裁定准予扣押京華廣場土地，目前鼎越公司已於6月提出第4次抗告，案件進度仍待台灣高等法院更審及裁定。
陳穎俊也說明，在容積獎勵撤銷及變更設計案部分，台北市政府於5月22日撤銷20％容積獎勵，鼎越公司則在6月申請建照變更設計展期，預計本(9)月底提送變更建照設計報告送審。
此外，目前截至今年8月底，鼎越開發與銀行的聯貸案借款餘額為58.8億元，中石化表示，後續將與銀行團討論還款規劃。
中石化今年上半年營收為80億元、年減30%，稅後淨損19.86億元、每股淨損為0.52元。
中石化高層表示，公司上半年在本業營運改善下，對稅後損益挹注了7.39億元，但因已喪失對中華工程(2515-TW)重大影響力，將依會計準則重估股權並認列投資損失18.04億元，目前該項虧將屬會記帳面上重估，不影響日常公司營運資金。
paras_en: Sinopec (1314‑TW) held its earnings briefing today (Nov 11). The market continues to watch the progress of the Jinghua Plaza project, which is wholly owned by Sinopec’s subsidiary Dingyue Development. General Manager Chen Ying‑jun said everything will follow the resolution of Dingyue’s shareholders’ meeting on May 22, 2026, which proposes to sell the land at a 7.28‑fold floor‑area ratio. The subsequent steps will comply with relevant regulations and laws. He also noted that Dingyue has filed its fourth appeal, which is pending a higher‑court review and ruling. The land‑disposition matter will be handled according to law, and a revised building‑permit design report is expected to be submitted for review by the end of September.

Regarding the ongoing seizure of the Jinghua Plaza land, Chen said the Taipei District Court ruled for the fourth time on April 8 of this year to allow the seizure. Dingyue filed its fourth appeal in June, and the case now awaits a review and decision by the Taiwan High Court.

Chen also explained that, concerning the removal of floor‑area bonuses and the design‑change case, the Taipei City Government revoked a 20 % floor‑area bonus on May 22. Dingyue applied in June for an extension of the building‑permit design deadline, and it plans to submit the revised design report for approval by the end of September.

As of the end of August this year, Dingyue Development’s syndicated loan balance with banks stood at NT$5.88 billion. Sinopec said it will discuss repayment plans with the lending consortium moving forward.
Sinopec’s revenue for the first half of this year was NT$8.0 billion, a 30 % year‑over‑year decline. After‑tax net loss was NT$1.986 billion, or a loss of NT$0.52 per share.

Senior executives said that, thanks to improvements in core operations, the company injected NT$7.39 billion into after‑tax earnings in the first half. However, having lost significant influence over China Engineering (2515‑TW), Sinopec will re‑value its stake under accounting standards and recognize an investment loss of NT$1.804 billion. This loss is an accounting revaluation and does not affect the company’s day‑to‑day operating cash.

items.title: 高公局推國道服務區響應敬軍優惠 統一超、全家4超商響應支援
items.title_en: Highway Bureau Launches Military Appreciation Discounts at Expressway Service Areas; Uni-President, FamilyMart among Four Retailers Support
paras: 為感念國軍長年守護家園，交通部高速公路局今(2026)年也結合各國道服務區經營廠商，推出「93軍人節敬軍優惠」，向所有國軍及眷屬表達誠摯敬意，活動自8月28日至9月10日舉辦，共1,186人次使用、年增成長14％。
高公局表示，此次活動也感謝南仁湖(5905-TW)、新東陽、統一超商(2912-TW)及全家便利商店(5903-TW)，總計共4家經營廠商全力支持與積極響應，於15處服務區指定櫃位，凡出示軍人證或榮民證等，即可享有9折優惠。
高公局表示，今年累計使用1,186次，較去(2025)年1,040次成長14％，其中更以西螺、南投及西湖服務區3個服務區使用最為踴躍。
在服務區消費的國軍朋友表示，收假兵車停靠服務區，剛好有軍人專屬優惠，覺得很棒；九三軍人節享有國道服務區商品9折優惠，感受到滿滿的敬意與支持；平時執行任務辛苦，能在休假或行車途中享有這份優惠，真的很貼心；感謝國道服務區對國軍的支持與肯定，讓我們感受到被記得、被重視的溫暖。高公局表示，這也顯示國軍朋友與眷屬的熱烈支持，也讓更多用路人看見敬軍活動的友善貼心，正是高公局與業者共同展現的溫暖心意。
高公局表示，國軍官兵是國家安定的堅實力量，不論是日常戰備演訓，或是災後的兵力支援，皆能看見他們無私奉獻的身影，希望透過專屬優惠，讓平日辛勞的國軍朋友在出遊或返鄉時，能在國道服務區獲得更好的放鬆體驗。
paras_en: In gratitude for the armed forces’ long‑standing protection of the homeland, the Ministry of Transportation’s Expressway Bureau this year (2026) partnered with operators of national highway service areas to launch the “93rd Military Day Appreciation Discount.” The program, running from August 28 to September 10, expresses sincere respect to all military personnel and their families, recording 1,186 uses and a year‑over‑year increase of 14 %.

The bureau said the event also thanks the four participating operators—Nan Renhu (5905‑TW), Xin Dongyang, Uni-President Convenience Stores (2912‑TW) and FamilyMart (5903‑TW)—which fully support and actively respond by offering a 10 % discount at designated counters in 15 service areas for anyone presenting a military ID or veteran’s card.
The bureau reported a total of 1,186 uses this year, up 14 % from 1,040 uses in 2025, with the most enthusiastic participation observed at the Xiluo, Nantou and Xihu service areas.

Military personnel who shopped at the service areas said that after returning from leave, their troop vehicles stopped at the service area and they were pleased to find a discount just for them. They appreciated the 10 % discount on goods during the 93rd Military Day, feeling the respect and support. They noted that the discount is a thoughtful gesture for those who work hard on missions, and thanked the service areas for recognizing and valuing them, which made them feel remembered and cared for. The bureau said this also shows the strong backing from service members and their families, and helps other road users see the friendly, considerate nature of the military‑appreciation activities, reflecting the warm intent jointly demonstrated by the bureau and operators.

The bureau emphasized that military personnel are a solid force for national stability. Whether in daily combat readiness training or post‑disaster troop support, their selfless dedication is evident. Through this exclusive discount, the bureau hopes that service members can enjoy a more relaxing experience at expressway service areas when traveling or returning home.

items.title: Fed升息幾乎成定局反而大漲？美股接下來才是真正考驗
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Almost Certain Yet Stocks Surge? The Real Test for US Equities Lies Ahead
paras: 美國8月通膨數據幾乎確立聯準會(Fed)下周升息1碼的預期，為9月初連續下挫的美股提供些許確定性。然而，升息答案塵埃落定，不代表市場已擺脫困境，高油價、美債殖利率、消費力下滑及企業獲利能否延續成長，仍是年底前的主要考驗。
8月消費者物價指數(CPI)整體與核心月增幅均高於預期。富蘭克林坦伯頓研究院首席投資策略師Jeff Schulze表示，數據顯示基礎通膨壓力仍具黏性，Fed必須升息才能讓通膨重返2%目標，甚至可能在短期內多次升息，但這項預期本身不會成為風險資產的重大推力。
芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估Fed下周升息1碼的機率達84%，高於一個月前的50%；年底前再次升息的機率也升至63%。

油價與殖利率仍是美股兩大逆風

投資人暫時對升息預期感到安心，標普500指數周五開盤一度大漲逾75點，收復本周部分跌幅。更重要的是，10年期美債殖利率在逼近5%後回落3個基點至4.92%，暫時解除估值壓力。
波灣國家可能開會協商和平方案的消息傳出後，布蘭特原油下跌3%至每桶104.50美元，也提振市場情緒。不過，油價過去兩個月已上漲約37%，並連續3個交易日站在100美元上方。
美國汽油均價升至每加侖4.30美元，較去年同期上漲近35%；柴油更首度突破每加侖6美元。能源成本上漲勢必陸續反映在未來數月的通膨數據，並與8月核心物價升溫相互作用，進一步侵蝕家庭購買力。
密西根大學9月消費者信心指數降至47.8，較8月下跌近4點，也接近今年低點。高油價若持續壓縮民眾荷包，可能削弱年底購物旺季的消費支出，對零售商與整體經濟構成壓力。

企業獲利能否撐起高估值？

Edward Jones資深全球策略師Angelo Kourkafas表示，美債殖利率與油價同時攀升，正考驗市場韌性，但美股尚未失去最重要的支柱，也就是快速成長的企業獲利。
問題在於，第三季財報季要到10月13日摩根大通(JPM-US)公布業績才正式展開。在此之前，市場難以忽視油價、就業市場不確定性、龐大AI投資支出及美債殖利率上升等壓力。
華爾街目前預估，標普500成分股第三季合計獲利將達7,687億美元，年增近30%，科技股與銀行股仍將領跑。若企業獲利未能達到如此樂觀的預期，美股估值恐面臨重新調整。
eToro美國投資分析師Bret Kenwell認為，Fed下周的政策論述將決定債市下一步。若Fed把升息形容為防範通膨再起的保險措施，而非長期升息循環的起點，市場可能把它解讀為「鴿派升息」，有助限制長期美債殖利率繼續上揚。
標普500目前僅較5月中旬上漲2.3%，華爾街年底預測中位數也只意味約4%的上漲空間。距離11月期中選舉僅剩53天，在財報季登場前，美股仍須穿越高油價、高殖利率與政策不確定性構成的重重障礙。
paras_en: US August inflation data has almost cemented expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates by one quarter-point next week, giving a bit of certainty to the US stock market that has been slipping since early September. However, the rate‑hike decision being settled does not mean the market has escaped its challenges; high oil prices, Treasury yields, weakening consumer spending and whether corporate earnings can keep growing remain the main tests before year‑end.

August CPI and core CPI both rose month‑over‑month more than expected. Jeff Schulze, chief investment strategist at Franklin Templeton, said the data shows underlying inflation pressure remains sticky, forcing the Fed to hike rates to bring inflation back to its 2% target and possibly raise rates multiple times in the short term, but that expectation itself will not become a major catalyst for risk assets.
The CME FedWatch tool shows the market’s probability of a one‑quarter‑point Fed hike next week at 84%, up from 50% a month ago; the odds of another hike before year‑end have also risen to 63%.

Oil prices and yields remain the two biggest headwinds for US stocks. Investors are temporarily reassured by the rate‑hike outlook, with the S&P 500 jumping more than 75 points on Friday’s open and recouping part of the week’s losses. More importantly, the 10‑year Treasury yield slipped three basis points to 4.92% after nearing 5%, temporarily easing valuation pressure.

After news that Gulf states might meet to negotiate a peace plan, Brent crude fell 3% to $104.50 a barrel, lifting market sentiment. Still, oil has risen about 37% over the past two months and has stayed above $100 for three consecutive trading days.

U.S. gasoline averaged $4.30 per gallon, up nearly 35% from a year ago, and diesel broke $6 per gallon for the first time. Rising energy costs will inevitably feed into inflation data over the coming months and, together with hotter August core prices, further erode household purchasing power.

The University of Michigan’s September consumer sentiment index fell to 47.8, down almost four points from August and near this year’s low. Persistently high oil prices could squeeze household budgets, potentially weakening consumer spending during the year‑end shopping season and putting pressure on retailers and the broader economy.

Can corporate earnings sustain lofty valuations? Angelo Kourkafas, senior global strategist at Edward Jones, said that rising Treasury yields and oil prices are testing market resilience, but US equities have not lost their most important pillar – fast‑growing corporate profits.

The issue is that the third‑quarter earnings season does not officially begin until JPMorgan (JPM‑US) reports results on October 13. Until then, markets can’t ignore pressures from oil prices, labor‑market uncertainty, massive AI investment outlays and climbing Treasury yields.

Wall Street currently estimates that S&P 500 constituents will generate $768.7 billion in Q3 earnings, up nearly 30% year‑over‑year, with tech and banks leading the growth. If corporate profits fall short of this optimistic outlook, US stock valuations could face a fresh adjustment.

eToro US analyst Bret Kenwell believes the Fed’s policy language next week will dictate the next move in the bond market. If the Fed frames the hike as an insurance measure against a resurgence of inflation rather than the start of a long‑term tightening cycle, markets may read it as a “dovish hike,” helping to cap further rises in long‑term Treasury yields.

The S&P 500 is up only 2.3% since mid‑May, and Wall Street’s median year‑end forecast implies roughly a 4% upside. With just 53 days left until the November midterm elections and earnings season still ahead, US stocks must still navigate the heavy obstacles of high oil prices, high yields and policy uncertainty.

items.title: 「要嘛行動、要嘛閉嘴」火熱CPI逼華許兌現鷹派承諾 Fed下周升息箭在弦上
items.title_en: "Either Act or Shut Up" – Hot CPI Forces Warsh to Deliver on Hawkish Promise, Fed Rate Hike Likely Next Week
paras: 美國8月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)升幅高於預期，讓聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在下周政策會議支持升息的壓力陡增。市場認為，這份數據不僅削弱通膨即將自行降溫的論點，也讓華許難以在發表強硬抗通膨演說後繼續按兵不動。
美國勞工統計局周五(11日)公布，排除食品與能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，顯示潛在物價壓力仍然頑強。Inflation Insights創辦人兼總裁Omair Sharif表示，Fed如今已到「拿出行動、否則就閉嘴」的時刻。
數據公布後，聯邦基金期貨顯示，市場預估Fed於9月15日至16日會議升息的機率，由周四約70%躍升至85%以上，並開始押注12月前可能再升息一次。道明銀行(TD Bank)與摩根大通(JPM-US)等機構的經濟學家也轉而預測Fed下周將調高利率。
畢馬威(KPMG)首席經濟學家Diane Swonk表示，最新數據進一步讓Fed政策重心朝升息傾斜，現在的問題已不是是否升息，而是需要升多少才能遏制通膨。

華許公信力面臨關鍵考驗

8月核心通膨上升，很大一部分來自無線通訊服務價格創紀錄上漲。儘管這可能是一次性因素，多名分析師仍認為，Fed已無法繼續單憑未來物價可能改善的期待維持利率不變。
華許8月28日在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會表示，潛在通膨尚未明顯改善，若新數據無法讓官員確信通膨正朝2%目標前進，Fed便「仍有工作要做」。Omair Sharif直言，華許不可能發表這樣的演說，卻不在下一次會議支持升息。
Fed今年已連續5次維持利率不變，但內部支持緊縮的聲浪持續升高。7月會議有3名官員反對按兵不動，主張升息1碼，另有2名不具投票權的官員表示也會支持升息。
Evercore ISI經濟學家團隊認為，下周升息如今幾乎已成定局。華許可能判斷，通膨數據尚不足以忽略油價帶來的額外壓力，並藉由採取行動修補7月記者會後受損的抗通膨公信力，且有望取得多數決策官員支持。

升息恐引爆華許與川普衝突

升息雖有助鞏固華許的抗通膨立場，卻可能激怒任命他的美國總統川普。川普持續要求Fed降息，上周甚至威脅，如果央行不降低利率，將切斷與部分國家的貿易。
白宮國家經濟會議主任Kevin Hassett表示，如果Fed採取重大行動，川普很可能會公開表態。這意味華許一旦支持升息，恐首度與仍稱他為Fed「出色新領袖」的川普正面衝突。
通膨風險也不只來自CPI。伊朗戰事延燒，布蘭特原油周四一度升至每桶109美元；資料中心建設帶來的龐大需求，也被認為不會迅速消退。密西根大學調查顯示，消費者一年期通膨預期由8月的4%升至9月初的4.6%，且自2023年以來首次有過半受訪者預期未來一年利率將上升。
在失業率維持低檔、勞動市場大致穩定，且部分官員認為現行利率對需求的抑制程度低於原先預期之際，Fed可能需要收回去年因擔憂就業降溫而實施的3次、合計3碼降息。多數投資人預期，這波調整可能僅升息一至兩次，但部分經濟學家已開始認為，Fed可能需要完全逆轉去年的降息措施。
paras_en: The U.S. August core consumer price index (CPI) rose more than expected, sharply increasing pressure on Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh to support a rate hike at next week’s policy meeting. Markets believe the data not only weakens the argument that inflation will cool on its own, but also makes it difficult for Warsh to stay idle after delivering a tough anti‑inflation speech.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released on Friday the 11th that core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, indicating that underlying price pressures remain stubborn. Omair Sharif, founder and president of Inflation Insights, said the Fed is now at the point of “take action or shut up.”

After the data were released, federal‑funds futures showed the market’s probability of a Fed rate hike at the September 15‑16 meeting jumping from about 70% on Thursday to over 85%, and traders began betting on another hike before December. Economists at TD Bank and JPMorgan (JPM‑US) also shifted to forecasting a rate increase next week.

KPMG chief economist Diane Swonk said the latest data further tilt the Fed’s policy focus toward tightening; the question now is not whether to hike, but how much tightening is needed to curb inflation.

Warsh’s credibility faces a crucial test. The August core‑inflation rise was largely driven by a record jump in wireless communication service prices. Although this may be a one‑off factor, several analysts say the Fed can no longer keep rates unchanged based solely on hopes that prices will improve later.

Warsh told the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit on August 28 that underlying inflation has not shown a clear improvement, and if new data do not convince officials that inflation is moving toward the 2% target, the Fed “still has work to do.” Omair Sharif bluntly noted that Warsh cannot give such a speech and then not support a hike at the next meeting.

The Fed has kept rates steady for five consecutive meetings this year, but internal support for tightening continues to rise. At the July meeting, three officials voted against holding rates steady, advocating a 0.25‑point hike, and two non‑voting members also indicated they would back a hike.

Evercore ISI economists say a rate hike next week is now almost a certainty. Warsh may conclude that inflation data are still insufficient to ignore the extra pressure from oil prices, and by acting he can repair the credibility damage to his anti‑inflation stance after the July press conference, while likely securing a majority of voting officials’ support.

Rate hikes could spark a clash between Warsh and President Trump. While a hike would reinforce Warsh’s anti‑inflation position, it could anger President Trump, who appointed him. Trump has repeatedly urged the Fed to cut rates and even threatened last week to cut off trade with certain countries if the central bank does not lower rates.

White House National Economic Council director Kevin Hassett said that if the Fed takes a major action, Trump is likely to comment publicly. This means that if Warsh backs a hike, it could be the first direct confrontation with Trump, who still calls him the Fed’s “outstanding new leader.”

Inflation risks also come from sources beyond CPI. The war in Iran has escalated, pushing Brent crude to $109 a barrel on Thursday, and massive demand from data‑center construction is seen as unlikely to fade quickly. A University of Michigan survey shows one‑year consumer inflation expectations rose from 4% in August to 4.6% in early September, and for the first time since 2023, over half of respondents expect interest rates to rise over the next year.

With unemployment remaining low, the labor market broadly stable, and some officials believing that current rates are less restrictive to demand than previously thought, the Fed may need to roll back the three 0.25‑point cuts it implemented last year out of employment‑cooling concerns. Most investors expect the adjustment to involve only one or two hikes, but some economists now argue the Fed may have to fully reverse last year’s easing measures.

items.title: 油價緩衝用完了！雪佛龍CEO警告未來數月恐續漲
items.title_en: Chevron CEO Warns Oil Price Buffer Exhausted, Future Months May See Further Increases
paras: 雪佛龍(Chevron)(CVX-US)執行長沃斯(Mike Wirth)周五(11日)警告，伊朗戰爭初期用來抑制油價漲勢的額外供應緩衝已經耗盡，未來幾個月油價風險仍偏向上行，短期內恐難迅速回落。
伊朗戰爭自2月底爆發後，多國陸續釋出部分原油庫存，美國也放寬對受制裁國家海上浮動石油庫存的限制，增加市場供應並減緩油價漲勢。然而，沃斯在德州大學奧斯汀分校一場能源會議上表示，這些緩衝措施的效用如今已經消耗殆盡。
沃斯表示，目前已很難想像油價能夠迅速走低，未來數月價格風險仍明顯偏向上行。伊朗戰爭與烏克蘭持續攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，正同步壓縮全球原油與成品油供應。美國柴油均價周四首度升至每加侖6美元，創歷史新高，布蘭特原油本周漲幅也可望達到8%。
談及中亞業務，沃斯表示，川普政府已與烏克蘭討論對俄羅斯黑海地區石油基礎設施的攻擊，此後雪佛龍在當地營運受到的衝擊已經減少。
雪佛龍負責營運哈薩克大型田吉茲油田，並持有裏海石油管線公司股權。該公司營運一條從田吉茲油田通往黑海的出口管線，是哈薩克原油出口的重要通道。
至於委內瑞拉業務，沃斯表示，雪佛龍計劃投入70億美元擴大當地產能，但不會從外部注入資金，相關支出將完全由目前3家合資企業產生的現金支應。
雪佛龍上周已與委內瑞拉政府簽署新合約條款，準備拓展至另外兩個油區，並計劃在2031年前把當地產量提高逾一倍，達到每日約60萬桶。沃斯強調，公司將依照現有合資企業自身創造現金的能力推動擴張。
paras_en: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth warned on Friday the extra supply buffer that was used early in the Iran war to curb oil price gains has been depleted, and oil price risk will remain tilted upward for the next several months, making a rapid decline unlikely in the short term.

Since the Iran war erupted at the end of February, multiple countries have gradually released portions of their crude inventories, and the United States has relaxed restrictions on offshore floating oil storage for sanctioned nations, boosting market supply and tempering price gains. However, Wirth said at an energy conference at the University of Texas at Austin that the effectiveness of those buffer measures has now been exhausted.

Wirth said it is now hard to imagine oil prices falling quickly, and price risk will remain clearly upward in the coming months. The Iran war together with continued attacks on Russian refineries due to the Ukraine conflict are simultaneously squeezing global crude and product supplies. U.S. diesel averaged $6 per gallon on Thursday for the first time, a historic high, and Brent crude is expected to post an 8% gain this week.

Regarding Central Asian operations, Wirth noted that the Trump administration had discussed attacks on Russian Black Sea oil infrastructure with Ukraine, and since then the impact on Chevron’s operations in the region has lessened.
Chevron operates Kazakhstan’s large Tengiz field and holds a stake in the Caspian Pipeline Consortium, which runs a pipeline from Tengiz to the Black Sea and is a key export route for Kazakh crude.

On Venezuelan business, Wirth said Chevron plans to invest $7 billion to expand local capacity but will not inject external funding; the related spending will be fully covered by cash generated by its three existing joint ventures.

Chevron signed new contract terms with the Venezuelan government last week, preparing to expand into two additional oil areas and aiming to more than double local production to about 600,000 barrels per day by 2031. Wirth emphasized the expansion will be driven by the cash‑generating ability of the current joint ventures.

items.title: 手機資費竟成最後一根稻草！美國核心通膨超預期 Fed下周恐升息
items.title_en: Mobile Phone Rates End Up as the Final Straw! U.S. Core Inflation Beats Expectations, Fed May Raise Rates Next Week
paras: 美國一波手機資費調漲，意外成為推升8月核心通膨的重要因素，甚至可能成為促使聯準會(Fed)下周升息的最後一根稻草。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五公布，排除食品與能源的核心消費者物價指數(CPI)8月月增0.3%，高於《彭博》調查預估的0.2%。其中，無線電話服務價格單月大漲5.9%，創有紀錄以來最大增幅，並對核心CPI月增率貢獻約0.1個百分點。
換句話說，若排除無線電話服務價格的影響，8月核心CPI月增率僅約0.2%，將與市場預期一致。這項指標主要反映電信業者提供的預付方案與月租方案價格。
美國銀行(BAC-US)、巴克萊(BCS-US)及Pantheon Macroeconomics的經濟學家指出，AT&T(T-US)、T-Mobile US(TMUS-US)等大型電信業者近期調整資費方案，很可能是無線電話服務價格暴漲的主因。
AT&T今年稍早已宣布，部分方案將於8月調漲價格；T-Mobile近期也停止提供若干舊有方案，導致部分用戶必須轉用價格更高的服務。BLS拒絕進一步說明個別電信業者的方案調整如何影響這項數據。
儘管核心通膨超預期可能主要受到一次性因素推動，許多Fed觀察人士仍認為升息理由充分。Inflation Insights總裁謝里夫(Omair Sharif)表示，無線電話服務確實讓核心CPI多出0.1個百分點，排除後的增幅只有0.2%，但Fed在下周會議上恐怕沒有餘裕逐項拆解數據，忽略整體通膨高於預期的結果。
由於8月CPI是Fed決策前最後一項重要通膨數據，這波由手機資費造成的意外漲幅，可能足以讓原本勢均力敵的利率決策倒向升息。
paras_en: A wave of mobile phone rate hikes in the United States unexpectedly became an important factor pushing up core inflation in August, and could even be the final straw that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise rates next week.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released on Friday that the core consumer price index (CPI) for August, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, above Bloomberg’s forecast of 0.2%. Within that, wireless telephone service prices jumped 5.9% in the month, the largest increase on record, contributing about 0.1 percentage point to the core CPI’s monthly gain.

In other words, if the impact of wireless telephone service prices is stripped out, the August core CPI would have risen only about 0.2% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations. This component mainly reflects the prices of prepaid and postpaid plans offered by telecom operators.

Economists at Bank of America (BAC‑US), Barclays (BCS‑US) and Pantheon Macroeconomics said that large carriers such as AT&T (T‑US) and T‑Mobile US (TMUS‑US) recently adjusted their pricing plans, which is likely the main driver of the surge in wireless telephone service prices.

AT&T announced earlier this year that some plans would see price increases in August; T‑Mobile has recently stopped offering several legacy plans, forcing some customers to switch to higher‑priced services. The BLS declined to provide further detail on how individual carriers’ plan changes affected the data.

Although the upside in core inflation may be driven largely by a one‑off factor, many Fed watchers still see ample justification for a rate hike. Omair Sharif, president of Inflation Insights, said that wireless telephone service added 0.1 percentage point to core CPI; without it the increase would be only 0.2%, but the Fed is unlikely to have time at next week’s meeting to dissect the numbers item by item, and will likely overlook the overall inflation being higher than expected.

Because the August CPI is the last major inflation data point before the Fed’s decision, this unexpected rise caused by mobile phone rates could be enough to tip a previously evenly balanced rate‑policy decision toward a hike.

items.title: 俄烏中東「雙戰事」夾擊！柴油、小麥接連告急 全球通膨風暴恐再起
items.title_en: Russia-Ukraine and Middle East “Dual War” Squeeze: Diesel and Wheat Shortages Spark Global Inflation Storm
paras: 中東戰爭再度升溫之際，在數千英里之外的俄烏戰爭也進入艱難的新階段，而這對全球經濟構成的威脅，遠不只是柴油與其他燃料。
俄羅斯與烏克蘭都是全球主要穀物出口國，俄羅斯同時也是燃料出口大國。近幾周，俄羅斯持續對基輔發動致命攻擊，烏克蘭則以更精準的方式襲擊俄羅斯能源基礎設施，造成巨大破壞。
這已成為美國柴油與汽油零售價格上漲的重要因素之一，進一步排擠美國家庭的預算，並加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。
然而，受衝擊的不只是燃料。黑海穀物碼頭遭到攻擊，威脅包括小麥在內的重要糧食出口，加上北半球收成季與冬季即將到來，來自中東的肥料供應仍不順暢。
哥倫比亞大學全球能源政策中心研究員、曾任油田服務巨頭SLB董事的Tatiana Mitrova說：「我正在觀察事態如何發展，我真的感到非常害怕。」
令人擔憂的理由不計可數，俄烏衝突持續升溫之際，川普政府上周末派遣特使庫許納(Jared Kushner)與魏科夫(Steve Witkoff)前往莫斯科與基輔訪問，但沒有取得突破性進展。
俄羅斯目前禁止柴油出口，導致每日約80萬桶柴油出口供應退出市場，這些燃料主要在未受到制裁的市場供應，包括土耳其、巴西及部分非洲國家。如今，這些國家被迫緊急尋找替代供應，產生的骨牌效應是讓歐洲柴油庫存降到危險的低點，美國業者得以介入填補缺口。
最新發展讓美國煉油商Marathon Petroleum(MPC-US)與Valero Energy(VLO-US)上季獲利均大幅飆升，股價也在近幾個交易日屢創新高。但對美國經濟、乃至於全球市場而言，這並不是好消息。
標普全球能源(S&P Global Energy)美洲與歐洲煉油及行銷主管Debnil Chowdhury說：「中東危機掩蓋了俄羅斯供應中斷，以及這對全球柴油供應造成的巨大衝擊。」
他指出，在公共討論中，柴油價格往往被汽油的話題熱度蓋過，但「柴油才是真正的主力燃料」。
Chowdhury表示，柴油價格上漲不會立即反映在消費者的支出上，反而會帶來複合效應，在未來三到六個月逐步傳導至整體經濟。
Chowdhury補充說：「我們正密切關注這一點，在實際層面上，這可能轉化為接下來到年底、及明年的經濟成長疲弱。我們處於一個岌岌可危的局面。」
數據平台Kpler的分析師預估，包括柴油與汽油煉製在內，目前全球煉油產能每日約為8000萬桶，低於往年常見的每日8600萬桶。
此外，近期中東衝突再度升溫，正在打擊沙烏地阿拉伯煉油廠及其他能源設施。俄羅斯約40%的煉油產能目前處於停擺狀態。
Enverus Intelligence Research能源分析師兼主管Al Salazar說：「就算手上有原油、荷姆茲海峽沒有受到限制，而且假設一切都恢復正常，我們仍然無法把原油轉化為成品油。」他解釋，人們消費的不是原油，而是由原油煉製而成的燃料。
原油期貨周四再度大漲，拖累股票與債券市場。倫敦交易的布蘭特原油期貨如今突破每桶107美元，紐約交易的西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨也站上每桶102美元，兩者今年來累積上漲近80%。小麥期貨今年迄今上漲逾46%，其中約一半漲幅在過去三個月出現。

攻擊範圍擴大、衝擊隨之擴散

哥大的Mitrova表示，烏克蘭約從一年前開始對俄羅斯煉油廠及能源基礎設施發動無人機攻擊，但之後持續調整攻擊方式，破壞力也與日俱增。舉例來說，本周三一場無人機攻擊，造成俄羅斯新烏連戈伊(Novy Urengoy)市附近的天然氣設施起火。
無人機不只擴大攻擊範圍，也擴大攻擊規模，壓垮了俄羅斯的防禦能力。比方說，烏克蘭會再次攻擊先前已遭襲擊的煉油廠，使維修工作更加複雜，並拉長煉油廠停擺的時間，而且近期的攻擊似乎經過精心安排，把目標鎖定能源設施中最昂貴、也最難替換的零組件，導致維修所需時間進一步拉長。
Mitrova表示，「俄羅斯持續修復，烏克蘭則是持續摧毀，就像是一場競賽。」
她指出，俄羅斯境內的燃料危機已經「非常明顯」，加油站開始出現排隊隊伍、部分地區實施配給，今年來官方燃料價格約上漲16%，但黑市價格高得多，甚至可能根本買不到燃料。
Mitrova表示，隨著冬季即將到來，情勢可能更加惡化，尤其是在基輔。
此外，黑海以小麥為主體的糧食出口，也面臨威脅。俄羅斯一直試圖透過波羅的海航線轉移穀物出口，但這僅占其黑海出口的一小部分。
她說：「隨著所有穀物被困在黑海，俄羅斯與烏克蘭都無法出口，而肥料又無法從波斯灣地區運來，加上『超級』聖嬰現象等天候因素影響全球農業，糧食安全將受到非常、非常嚴重的影響。」
她表示，到了明年，全球糧食安全將會受到非常明顯的影響，目前已經在新興經濟體已經可以看到這種現象。
paras_en: As the Middle East war heats up again, the Russia-Ukraine conflict thousands of miles away has entered a difficult new phase, posing threats to the global economy that go far beyond diesel and other fuels.

Both Russia and Ukraine are major global grain exporters, and Russia is also a large fuel exporter. In recent weeks Russia has continued lethal attacks on Kyiv, while Ukraine has struck Russian energy infrastructure with increasing precision, causing massive damage.
This has become one of the key drivers of rising retail diesel and gasoline prices in the United States, further squeezing household budgets and heightening market concerns about inflation.

But the impact is not limited to fuels. Attacks on Black Sea grain terminals threaten vital food exports, including wheat, and with the northern‑hemisphere harvest season and winter approaching, fertilizer supplies from the Middle East remain disrupted.

Tatiana Mitrova, a researcher at Columbia University’s Center on Global Energy Policy and former board member of oil‑field services giant SLB, said: “I am watching how the situation unfolds, and I am truly very scared.”

There are countless worrying reasons; as the Russia‑Ukraine clash intensifies, the Trump administration sent envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to Moscow and Kyiv last weekend, but achieved no breakthrough.

Russia has now banned diesel exports, removing roughly 800,000 barrels per day from the market. Those fuels mainly went to non‑sanctioned markets such as Turkey, Brazil and parts of Africa, which are now forced to scramble for alternatives, creating a domino effect that has driven European diesel inventories to dangerously low levels while U.S. firms step in to fill the gap.

The latest developments have sent U.S. refiners Marathon Petroleum (MPC‑US) and Valero Energy (VLO‑US) soaring in profit last quarter, with their shares hitting fresh highs over the past few trading days. Yet this is not good news for the U.S. economy or global markets.

Debnil Chowdhury, head of refining and marketing for the Americas and Europe at S&P Global Energy, said: “The Middle East crisis masks the Russian supply disruption and the huge impact it has on global diesel supply.”
He noted that in public debate diesel prices are often eclipsed by gasoline talk, but “diesel is the real workhorse fuel.”

Chowdhury added that diesel price hikes will not immediately show up in consumer spending; instead they will generate a compound effect that gradually transmits to the broader economy over the next three to six months.
He further said: “We are watching this closely; in practical terms it could translate into weaker economic growth by year‑end and into next year. We are in a precarious situation.”

Analysts at data platform Kpler estimate that global refining capacity – including diesel and gasoline production – is now about 80 million barrels per day, down from the usual 86 million barrels per day in prior years.
Moreover, the recent escalation of Middle East fighting is hitting Saudi Arabian refineries and other energy facilities. About 40 % of Russia’s refining capacity is currently offline.

Enverus Intelligence Research energy analyst and head Al Salazar said: “Even if we have crude oil, the Strait of Hormuz is unrestricted, and everything otherwise returns to normal, we still cannot turn crude into finished fuel.” He explained that people consume not crude oil but the fuels refined from it.

Crude oil futures surged again on Thursday, dragging down equity and bond markets. Brent crude on the London exchange broke above $107 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate in New York topped $102 a barrel, both up nearly 80 % year‑to‑date. Wheat futures have risen more than 46 % this year, with roughly half of that gain occurring in the past three months.

The attack scope is widening and the shock is spreading. Mitrova of Columbia University said Ukraine began drone strikes on Russian refineries and energy infrastructure about a year ago, and has since refined its tactics, increasing the damage. For example, a drone attack on Wednesday set a natural‑gas facility near Novy Urengoy on fire.

Drones are not only expanding the geographic reach of attacks but also their scale, overwhelming Russian defenses. Ukraine may strike the same refinery again, complicating repairs and extending shutdown times, and recent attacks appear meticulously planned to hit the most expensive and hardest‑to‑replace components of energy facilities, further lengthening repair periods.
Mitrova said, “Russia keeps repairing, Ukraine keeps destroying – it’s like a race.”

She noted that the fuel crisis inside Russia is already “very obvious,” with queues at gas stations, regional rationing, official fuel prices up about 16 % this year, while black‑market prices are far higher and fuel may simply be unavailable.
Mitrova warned that as winter approaches the situation could worsen, especially in Kyiv.

In addition, Black Sea wheat‑centric grain exports are under threat. Russia has tried to shift grain shipments through Baltic routes, but this accounts for only a small fraction of its Black Sea exports.

She said: “With all the grain trapped in the Black Sea, neither Russia nor Ukraine can export, fertilizer cannot be brought in from the Persian Gulf, and ‘super’ El Niño‑type weather patterns are hitting global agriculture. Food security will be hit extremely, extremely hard.”
She added that by next year global food security will be visibly impacted, and the effects are already observable in emerging economies.

paras: 美國9月初消費者信心大幅惡化，汽油價格上漲與貿易緊張升溫，加劇民眾對生活成本及通膨的擔憂，就連原本較支持川普政府經濟政策的共和黨選民也開始失去信心。
密西根大學周五(11日)公布，9月消費者信心指數初值由8月的51.7降至47.8，不僅遠低於市場預估的51，也低於《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測。民主黨與共和黨支持者的信心均明顯下降，獨立選民則大致持平。
分項數據顯示，現況指數由51.9降至50.9，消費者預期指數更由51.5驟降至45.8，創2022年7月以來最低。受訪者對目前及未來財務狀況的看法雙雙惡化，整體消費者信心較伊朗戰爭爆發前的2月低16%，也較去年同期下降13%。
隨著汽油價格升至歷年9月最高，美國民眾預期未來一年物價將上漲4.6%，高於8月的4%，並創6月以來最高。未來5至10年通膨預期則由3.3%微升至3.4%，高於2024年介於2.8%至3.2%的區間。
調查主管Joanne Hsu表示，燃料價格再度上漲及貿易緊張，讓消費者預期家庭財務將承受更大壓力。最新通膨報告也顯示，美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.4%，核心CPI月增0.3%，增幅高於預期。
市場升息預期也迅速擴散至一般民眾。9月有62%的受訪者預期未來一年利率將上升，高於8月的49%及一年前的23%，為2023年以來首次有過半消費者預期利率走高，顯示民眾普遍認為聯準會(Fed)將出手抑制通膨。
政治層面的不滿也在擴大。受訪者對政府經濟政策的評價9月惡化約10%，僅35%的共和黨支持者認為政府妥善處理經濟，創川普去年重返白宮以來最低。
儘管8月就業成長強勁且失業率持平，仍有61%的消費者預期未來一年失業率將上升，高於8月的57%。這份調查蒐集8月25日至9月7日的回覆，顯示高油價、通膨與利率疑慮正全面侵蝕美國家庭信心。
paras_en: US consumer confidence deteriorated sharply in early September, as rising gasoline prices and heightened trade tensions intensified worries about living costs and inflation, even causing traditionally Trump‑supporting Republican voters to lose confidence.

The University of Michigan released on Friday (the 11th) that the preliminary September consumer confidence index fell from August’s 51.7 to 47.8, well below the market forecast of 51 and lower than all economists surveyed by Bloomberg. Confidence among both Democratic and Republican supporters dropped markedly, while independents remained roughly unchanged.

Component data show the current‑conditions index slipped from 51.9 to 50.9, and the expectations index plunged from 51.5 to 45.8, the lowest since July 2022. Respondents’ views of their present and future financial situation both worsened, with overall consumer confidence 16% lower than in February before the Iran war and 13% lower than a year ago.

With gasoline prices climbing to the highest level ever recorded for a September, Americans now expect prices to rise 4.6% over the next year, up from 4% in August and the highest since June. Five‑to‑10‑year inflation expectations edged up from 3.3% to 3.4%, above the 2024 range of 2.8%‑3.2%.

Survey director Joanne Hsu said that the renewed surge in fuel prices and trade tensions are leading consumers to expect greater pressure on household finances. The latest inflation report also showed that US CPI rose 3.4% year‑over‑year in August, with core CPI up 0.3% month‑over‑month, both above expectations.

Expectations of rate hikes quickly spread to the broader public. In September, 62% of respondents anticipated higher interest rates in the next year, up from 49% in August and 23% a year earlier, marking the first time since 2023 that a majority expect rates to rise, indicating a broad belief that the Fed will act to curb inflation.

Political dissatisfaction is also widening. In September, evaluations of the government’s economic policies worsened by about 10%, and only 35% of Republican supporters said the government was handling the economy well, the lowest level since Trump returned to the White House last year.

Despite strong job growth and a steady unemployment rate in August, 61% of consumers now expect the unemployment rate to rise over the next year, up from 57% in August. The survey, which collected responses from August 25 to September 7, shows that high oil prices, inflation and rate concerns are eroding US household confidence across the board.

paras_en: U.S. equity indices opened higher on Friday (the 11th) as investors temporarily digested August’s hotter inflation and the pressure of a possible Fed rate hike next week, shifting focus to falling oil prices; the Dow surged more than 600 points at one point, and the S&P 500 fought to end a four‑day losing streak, the longest decline since June.

After the International Energy Agency cut its oil‑demand forecast for this year, Brent crude fell to $104 a barrel and U.S. Treasury yields slipped from multi‑year highs, prompting a simultaneous rebound in stocks and bonds.

Before the close, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 560 points, roughly 1.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose about 280 points, also near 1.1%, the S&P 500 gained about 1.0%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed 1.8%, and TSMC ADR rose about 1.2%.

U.S. equity index futures kept their upward momentum in pre‑market trading on Friday, but after August core inflation came in hotter than expected, they eased slightly as investors added bets that the Fed may raise rates next week.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that August’s Consumer Price Index rose 0.4% month‑over‑month and 3.4% year‑over‑year, both in line with expectations. Excluding the more volatile food and energy components, core CPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, above the 0.2% forecast, and 2.4% year‑over‑year, matching expectations.

Overall CPI was driven mainly by higher energy prices. Although most data matched forecasts, the faster‑than‑expected rise in core inflation shows underlying price pressures remain sticky, raising the odds of a Fed rate hike—the first in three years—before its policy meeting on September 15‑16, the last major inflation data point before that meeting.

After the data release, money‑market participants increased their bets on a Fed hike, with traders estimating about a 90% chance of a rate increase next week. The Fed‑sensitive two‑year Treasury yield rose two basis points to 4.61%, pushing bond prices lower.
U.S. stock futures trimmed some of their gains. At 8:34 a.m. Eastern Time, Dow futures were up 347 points, or 0.67%, S&P 500 futures rose 0.61%, and Nasdaq‑100 futures climbed 0.73%.

In the energy market, after the IEA lowered its oil‑demand outlook, Brent fell to $104 a barrel. Investors continue to digest the combined impact of inflation pressure, Fed policy outlook and oil‑price movements on the market.

As of about 9 p.m. Taipei time on Friday the 11th, the Dow was up 576.85 points, or 1.11%, at 52,640.95; the Nasdaq Composite rose 258.87 points, or 0.99%, to 26,340.59; the S&P 500 gained 73.62 points, or 0.97%, to 7,665.32; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed 144.43 points, or 1.24%, to 11,758.60; TSMC ADR rose 0.64% to $431.01; the 10‑year Treasury yield fell to 4.92%; NY light crude dropped 3.05% to $99.35 a barrel; Brent fell 2.82% to $104.59 a barrel; gold rose 0.44% to $4,426.70 an ounce; and the dollar index rose to 99.06. Highlighted stocks: GameStop (GME‑US) rose 3.33% in early trading to $21.07.

GameStop was up more than 3% pre‑market as CEO Ryan Cohen disclosed a purchase of 1 million shares at an average price of $20.375. Cohen now holds about 39.347 million shares, worth roughly $802 million at Thursday’s closing price.
Oracle (ORCL‑US) rose 1.82% in early trading to $155.72 per share.

Oracle surged more than 6% pre‑market after its fiscal first‑quarter results beat Wall Street expectations. Adjusted earnings were $1.92 per share, above the $1.74 consensus, and revenue was $19.35 billion, topping the $19.14 billion forecast. Cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubled to $7.4 billion, beating the $7.09 billion estimate.
Adobe (ADBE‑US) fell 1.37% in early trading to $245.33 per share.

Adobe slipped 4% pre‑market as its quarterly guidance was roughly in line with expectations. The company forecast adjusted earnings of $6.30‑$6.35 per share (consensus $6.32) and revenue of $6.8‑$6.85 billion (consensus $6.85 billion).

Key economic data released today: U.S. August CPI year‑over‑year 3.4% (expected 3.4%), month‑over‑month 0.4% (expected 0.4%, prior 0.1%); August core CPI year‑over‑year 2.4% (expected 2.4%, prior 2.5%), month‑over‑month 0.3% (expected 0.2%, prior 0.2%); preliminary September consumer confidence index expected 51.0, prior 51.7. Wall Street analysis: The latest Markets Pulse survey shows bond‑selling pressure rising, pushing Treasury yields toward levels that could trigger a 10% equity correction. About 30% of 122 respondents say a 10‑year yield of 5.0‑5.25% would cause a 10% market drop, while 22% cite a threshold of 5.25‑5.5%.

The benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield broke above 4.96% on Thursday, a three‑year high. The Trump administration’s conflict with Iran pushed oil above $100 a barrel, heightening concerns about rising inflation and Fed policy. RSM chief economist Joseph Brusuelas warned that markets may feel a long‑awaited equity correction is imminent, as real‑economy data and central‑bank actions force risk‑seeking investors to confront reality.
